prompt: A rectangular floor measures 12 feet by 15 feet. Carpet costs $18 per square yard. How many dollars does it cost to carpet the whole floor? (1 yard = 3 feet)
The sales tax rate in a town rose from 8 percent to 10 percent. By what percent did the sales tax on a $200 purchase increase?
Mara spent 40 percent of her money on a jacket. She then spent 25 percent of the money she had left on a scarf. After that she had $180. How many dollars did she have at the start?

The price of a jacket is 50 percent higher than the price of a coat. Then the price of the coat rises by 20 percent and the price of the jacket rises by 10 percent. The price of the jacket is now what percent higher than the price of the coat?

A jug holds 10 liters of pure apple juice. Two liters are poured out and replaced with 2 liters of water, and the jug is stirred. This is done two more times, three times in all. What percent of the liquid in the jug is now apple juice?

Cup P holds 100 milliliters of tea and cup Q holds 100 milliliters of milk. Twenty milliliters of tea are poured from P into Q, and Q is stirred well. Then 20 milliliters of the mixture in Q are poured back into P. How many milliliters of milk are now in cup P?

Without stops, a bus travels at an average speed of 75 kilometers per hour. Including the time it spends at stops, its average speed is 60 kilometers per hour. On average, how many minutes per hour does the bus spend stopped?

Printer A prints 50 pages per minute and printer B prints 30 pages per minute. A 1,200-page job is started on printer A alone. Some time later, printer B also starts printing pages of the same job, and both printers keep printing until the job is finished, 18 minutes after printer A started. For how many minutes did printer B print?
Working alone, pipe A fills a tank 5 hours faster than pipe B does working alone. With both pipes open, the tank fills in 6 hours. How many hours does pipe A take to fill the tank working alone?

Three friends share a taxi. Ana rides the whole 30-kilometer trip, Ben gets out after 18 kilometers, and Cho gets out after 6 kilometers. The fare is $90 for the whole trip, and the cost of each stretch is proportional to its length. The friends agree that the cost of each stretch is shared equally by the friends in the taxi during that stretch. How many dollars does Ana pay?

Two runners run around a 600-meter circular track, each at a constant speed. When they start together and run in opposite directions, they meet every 3 minutes. When they start together and run in the same direction, the faster runner passes the slower one every 12 minutes. What is the faster runner's speed, in meters per minute?
Walking at 3/4 of her usual speed, Mia reaches school 12 minutes later than usual. How many minutes does her usual walk to school take?

Working alone, Ana can build a fence in 6 days and Ben can build it in 9 days. Ana works alone for the first day; then Ben joins her, and they work together until the fence is finished. They are paid $450 for the fence and share it in proportion to the amount of work each did. How many dollars does Ana receive?

With both of its inlet pipes open, an empty tank fills in 12 minutes. One day pipe A was open alone for the first 10 minutes, and then pipe B alone filled the rest of the tank in 15 more minutes. How many minutes would pipe A alone take to fill the empty tank?

An escalator moves upward at a constant speed. Walking up it at 1 step per second, Lena reaches the top after taking 20 steps. Walking up it at 2 steps per second, she reaches the top after taking 32 steps. How many steps are visible on the escalator when it is stopped?
A triangle has two sides of lengths 10 and 13, and the length of its third side is a whole number. For how many different lengths of the third side is the triangle obtuse?
A triangle has sides of lengths 13, 13 and 10. A circle is drawn inside the triangle so that it touches all three sides. What is the radius of the circle?

Each of the 8 corners of a solid cube with edges 6 centimeters long is cut off by a single flat cut through the midpoints of the three edges that meet at that corner. What is the volume, in cubic centimeters, of the solid that remains?

A square is drawn inside a semicircle of radius 10 so that one side of the square lies along the diameter and the other two vertices of the square lie on the curved part of the semicircle. What is the area of the square?
A rhombus has diagonals 30 centimeters and 40 centimeters long. A circle is drawn inside the rhombus so that it touches all four sides. What is the radius of the circle, in centimeters?
Point P lies inside an equilateral triangle. The perpendicular distances from P to the three sides of the triangle are 2, 3 and 6 centimeters. What is the height of the triangle, in centimeters?
Two circles have radii 3 and 4, and their centers are 13 units apart. A point P is on the first circle and a point Q is on the second circle. What is the greatest possible length of segment PQ?

In triangle ABC, angle A measures 64 degrees and angle B is larger than angle C. The altitude from A to side BC and the bisector of angle A make an angle of 12 degrees with each other. What is the measure of angle B, in degrees?

A rectangular lawn measures 20 meters by 30 meters. Two straight paths, each 2 meters wide, cross the lawn: one runs the full length parallel to the 30-meter sides, and the other runs the full width parallel to the 20-meter sides. What is the area, in square meters, of the lawn that is not covered by the paths?

A goat is tied with a 16-meter rope to one outside corner of a barn whose floor is a square 12 meters on each side. The goat cannot go inside the barn, and the rope can bend around the corners of the barn. What is the area, in square meters, of the ground outside the barn that the goat can reach?

A square has sides 8 units long. A circle passes through two corners of the square that are at the ends of one side, and it touches the opposite side of the square at exactly one point. What is the radius of the circle?

In triangle ABC, point D is on side AB with AD equal to one third of AB, point E is on side BC with BE equal to one third of BC, and point F is on side CA with CF equal to one third of CA. What fraction of the area of triangle ABC is the area of triangle DEF?

A wheel of radius 2 centimeters rolls without slipping around the outside of a square whose sides are 10 centimeters long, always touching the square, until it returns to its starting position. How many centimeters does the center of the wheel travel?
In the coordinate plane, a circle touches both the x-axis and the y-axis and passes through the point (2, 9). What is the greatest possible radius of the circle?
In the coordinate plane, point P is (7, 3). Point P is rotated 90 degrees counterclockwise about the point C(2, 1). What are the coordinates of the image of P?
In the coordinate plane, what is the shortest distance from the origin to the line 3x + 4y = 24?
Three fair six-sided dice, each numbered 1 through 6, are rolled. What is the probability that the greatest of the three numbers showing is exactly 4?
How many four-digit positive integers have at least two digits that are the same? (For example, 1213 and 5005 are counted, but 1234 is not.)

Ana and Ben play a series of games. In each game Ana wins with probability 1/3 and Ben wins with probability 2/3, there are no ties, and the games are independent. The series ends as soon as Ana has won 2 games or Ben has won 3 games. What is the probability that Ana wins the series?
Two fair six-sided dice, each numbered 1 through 6, are rolled. What is the probability that the two numbers showing differ by at least 2?
Eight students are to be split into four teams of two students each. The teams are not named or numbered. In how many different ways can the eight students be split into teams?

Kim climbs a staircase of 8 steps. With each stride she climbs either 1 step or 2 steps. In how many different orders of strides can she climb from the bottom to the top? (For example, 2, 2, 2, 1, 1 and 1, 2, 2, 2, 1 are different orders.)

The mean of a list of ten numbers is 15. The mean of the first six numbers in the list is 12, and the mean of the last six numbers in the list is 20. What is the sum of the fifth and sixth numbers in the list?
In a club, 60 percent of the members play chess, 50 percent play go, and 15 percent play neither game. What fraction of the members who play chess also play go?

The mean score of the 25 students in a class was reported as 72. Later the teacher found two recording errors: one score was recorded as 47 but should have been 87, and another was recorded as 91 but should have been 61. What is the correct mean score of the class?

Jo's mean score on her first 4 tests is 83. She has 2 tests left, and each test is scored from 0 to 100. She wants her mean score on all 6 tests to be at least 85. What is the lowest score she can get on the fifth test and still be able to reach her goal?

Three people are chosen at random. Assume that each person is equally likely to have been born in any of the 12 months and that their birth months are independent. What is the probability that at least two of the three people were born in the same month?

A 3-person committee is to be chosen from a group of 8 people that includes Ann and Bob. Ann and Bob insist that either both of them are on the committee or neither of them is. How many different committees are possible?
What is the sum of all real numbers x that satisfy (x^2 - 3x)^2 - (x^2 - 3x) - 12 = 0 ?
If 2^x = 3 and 3^y = 4, what is the value of 2^(xy) ?

The function f is defined by f(x) = (x + 8)/(x - 1) for x not equal to 1. Starting with the number 5, f is applied 51 times in a row: first f(5) is found, then f of that result, and so on. What is the final result?
The numbers x and y satisfy -6 < x < 2 and -3 < y < 5. What is the greatest integer that could be the value of xy?
The equation x^2 + bx + 36 = 0, where b is an integer, has two solutions that are both integers (the two solutions are allowed to be equal). How many different values of b are possible?
For all numbers a and b, the operation diamond is defined by a diamond b = ab - 3a - 3b + 12. There is a number e such that a diamond e = a for every number a. What is the value of e?
The numbers x and y satisfy |x| + x = 10 and |y| - y = 12. What is the value of x + y?
Three consecutive even positive integers have a product that is 20 times their sum. What is the largest of the three integers?
The function f is defined by f(x) = 2x + 3. A function g is defined by g(x) = ax + b, where a and b are constants. For every number x, f(g(x)) = g(f(x)). If g(0) = 6, what is the value of g(1)?
In the sum 1 + 2 - 3 + 4 + 5 - 6 + 7 + 8 - 9 + ... + 97 + 98 - 99, every multiple of 3 is subtracted and every other number is added. What is the value of the sum?
The pages of a book are numbered 1, 2, 3, ..., n. When the page numbers were added, one page number was mistakenly added twice, and the result was 1000. Which page number was added twice?
When all of the positive divisors of 432, including 1 and 432, are multiplied together, the product can be written as 432^k. What is the value of k?
What is the least positive integer k for which 540k is a perfect square?
Two positive integers a and b, with a < b, have a sum of 168, and the greatest common factor of a and b is 4. How many such pairs (a, b) are there?
For how many integers n from 1 to 98, inclusive, is n^3 - n divisible by 5?
The number N is written using the digit 7 exactly 100 times and no other digits, so N = 777...7. What is the remainder when N is divided by 37?
The number 45 can be written as a sum of two or more consecutive positive integers in several ways; one way is 22 + 23. How many ways are there in all, including 22 + 23?
Which of the following numbers lies between 5/8 and 7/11 on the number line?
What is the value of 3/4 - 1/2 ÷ 2/3 × 1/4 ?

The digits a and b are each one of 1, 2, ..., 9 (they may be equal). The repeating decimal 0.abab... has the block ab repeating forever, and 0.baba... has the block ba repeating forever. How many different values can the sum 0.abab... + 0.baba... have?
